LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavegauntlet.description: A locking restraint glove used to secure a Mugirl's fingers tightly, significantly reducing manipulation and fine motor ability. The gloves are equipped with a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with an [Exquisite Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavegauntlet.label: Mugirl Slave Gauntlets
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavestockings.description: A special type of restraint stockings shaped similarly to high heels but without heels, making the wearer walk unsteadily with noticeably reduced movement speed. The stockings are equipped with a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with an [Exquisite Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavestockings.label: Mugirl Slave Stockings
